description: ADR-0043 decision 3: the text parameters of the built-in external_send tools that write human-readable text outside the platform. The worker appends the AI disclosure marker to each listed parameter before the call. A path is a top-level argument (`comment`) or a text field of each object in a top-level list (`inline_comments[].comment_text`). `format` markdown targets render HTML comments as hidden, so the marker carries the run id there; plain targets get the text only. Every external_send tool of tool-categories-v1.json is listed under toolkits or under exempt with a reason. Read by the Rust worker and by elitea-main (the opt-out toolkit types); elitea-main keeps a copy that a test holds equal.

jira.update_comment_with_file: Adds a file to a comment that exists. The tool writes no text of its own.
